# SUTTON CONSERVATION COMMISSION

## Meeting Minutes

**September 16, 2026**

Approved: Yes

Pursuant to Governor Healey's directive extending the temporary Open Meeting provisions until June 30, 2027, the Conservation Commission meeting will be conducted in a HYBRID format and will be recorded. *Recordings will be available on the Town's website and YouTube channel. *Please be aware: Participants attending via Zoom will have their video and audio disabled. *If you wish to engage in discussion, raise your hand; if acknowledged by the Chair, you will receive a pop-up message allowing you to unmute yourself. For agenda, YouTube, and Zoom links, please visit www.suttonma.org/cable-department.

Present in person: W. Wence, T. Thompson, J. Marran, B. Faneuf -consultant E. Anger-consultant

Unavailable: J. Duval. M. McGovern

## Public Hearing(s)

### 6:00 pm Abbreviated Notice of Resource Area Delineation (ANRAD) 563 Mendon Road DEP 303-1041

Motion: to waive reading T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

R. Mankaryous ANRAD, no comments from DEP- B. Faneuf made recommendation to issue ORAD.

Motion: close public hearing. T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

Motion: to issue ORAD T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

## Discussion

### RDA 19 Grace Ave D.Swatik Hazard Tree Removal

Motion: Issue negative determination T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

## Board Business

### Approve Minutes: 9/2/2026

Motion: To approve the minutes from 9/2/26 T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

### Certificate of Compliance

DEP 303-0987 110 Manchaug Road T. Mahoney

1 special condition-re-plant 25 bushes-was completed. B. Faneuf recommends COC

Motion: issue complete COC T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran- yes

## Project Update

**Lake Singletary:** B. Faneuf -update- DEP superseding OOC took over regarding lake draw down. DEP wants 3' draw down for protection of muscles and shellfish.

**45 Stone School Rd**- field change- shift driveway and pave.

J. Marran-make sure water stays on property and avoid going into the road.

## Enforcement Issues:

**72 Main Street-** B. Faneuf update- Douglas still reviewing.

**320 Putnam Hill Road-** J.Marran-update- contractor hired, installing silt fence. J. Marran to meet on site Mon.9/21

**126 Burbank Road** B. Faneuf update- work continuing

Motion to adjourn: T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, W. Wence-yes, T. Thompson - yes, J. Marran

Adjourned: 6:23 pm
